ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% high-intensity (white/cream) pixels to 15% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity field occupying the central interior. A continuous low-intensity (black) band follows the entire trailing edge boundary. Localized medium-intensity brownish-grey mottling is concentrated in the central-right lobe and near the peduncle interface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct irregular erosion and jagged trailing-edge topography on the left lobe, indicating non-uniform tissue loss or historical trauma.
